Attached to the camera is a black zoom lens.
The lens barrel has 'Nikon AF-S DX 70-300mm 1:4.5-5.6G ED' printed on it.
The camera body shows significant wear and dirt on the grip and the area around the shutter button.
The lens shows some minor surface scratches on the front glass in photo 0.
The photos are watermarked 'McSteve Online Gadget Store'.
